title: 9 Gifts for Pet Lovers Under $55 (Black Friday 2026)
description: Gifts for dog and cat lovers under $55: toys, a water fountain, a fur roller and walk gear, each with the honest catch.
lede: Nine gifts for anyone with a dog or cat, from a $9 toy to a fur roller they'll use weekly, sorted by pet with the one thing to know before you buy each.

hero.alt: A dog in a Santa hat sitting on a sofa

ticker: Dogs, cats and the whole home
One honest catch on every pick

top_picks.why: The one they'll use every week

bands.label: For dogs
bands.blurb: Toys and walk gear dogs (and owners) actually use.
bands.alt: A dog holding a plush toy

items.name: KONG Classic dog toy
items.alt: A beagle puppy chewing a toy
items.why: The stuffable rubber toy dog owners swear by. Fill it with treats to keep a dog busy.
items.catch: pick the right size for the dog; too small is a choking risk.

items.name: Snuffle mat
items.why: Hide kibble or treats in the fabric and the dog sniffs them out. An easy stocking filler.
items.catch: strong chewers can shred the fabric; supervise the first few uses.

items.name: Outward Hound Fun Feeder slow bowl
items.alt: A dog eating from a metal bowl
items.why: A maze-shaped bowl that turns a gulped dinner into a puzzle.
items.catch: the ridges need a brush to clean properly.
items.q: outward hound fun feeder slow bowl

items.name: Kurgo front-clip dog harness
items.alt: A man walking a dog on a lead
items.why: A padded harness with a front clip for more control on everyday walks.
items.catch: measure the dog's chest first; sizes are specific.

bands.label: For cats
bands.blurb: Play and water, the two things cats are fussy about.
bands.alt: A cat in a Santa hat among Christmas decorations

items.name: Cat water fountain
items.alt: A cat drinking water from a bowl
items.why: Many cats prefer moving water to a still bowl. Pick one with an easy-to-clean pump.
items.catch: filters need replacing regularly, a small ongoing cost.

items.name: SmartyKat Hot Pursuit cat toy
items.alt: A cat playing with a toy on the floor
items.why: A wand moves unpredictably under a fabric cover so cats can stalk and pounce.
items.catch: it runs on batteries and is noisy on hard floors.

items.name: Catstages Tower of Tracks
items.alt: A grey kitten sitting on the floor
items.why: Three levels of rolling balls for solo play. Cheap, cheerful and a good stocking filler.
items.catch: it's light and can slide on smooth floors.

bands.label: For every pet home
bands.blurb: For the owner as much as the pet.
bands.alt: A beagle puppy asleep on a sofa

items.name: ChomChom reusable pet hair roller
items.alt: A dog on a brown sofa
items.why: Lifts pet hair off sofas and beds with no sticky sheets to replace. A gift they'll use every week.
items.catch: it works best on upholstery, less well on clothes.

items.name: FURminator deShedding tool
items.why: A grooming tool that pulls out loose undercoat before it ends up on the sofa.
items.catch: pick the long- or short-hair version to match the pet's coat.

method: We cross-checked this season's pet gift guides with dated retailer prices and kept simple gifts that suit most dogs and cats. Prices were checked on 12 November 2026 and change daily around Black Friday, so check the price before you buy. We don't make health claims about any pet product.
updates: 12 November 2026: expanded to 9 picks for dogs, cats and the home. Prices approximate; recheck before buying.

sources.name: Gifting Machine: best gifts for pet lovers (2026)
